ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ratio with a dominant low-intensity (black) background and approximately 8-12% localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Numerous small white annular rings (5-15 pixels in diameter) distributed across both lobes; one distinct white linear streak located on the inner portion of the left lobe extending toward the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped notch with an estimated angle of 55 degrees; the base of the notch is occluded by high-intensity water spray pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with high-frequency oscillations; pixel amplitudes of peaks and valleys range from 2 to 12 pixels across the span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep toward the distal tips, following a roughly parabolic curve on the upper edges of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Widespread detection of circular and annular white pixel clusters (resembling barnacle scars) concentrated in the central and trailing regions of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent vertical linear high-contrast mark on the left lobe; several smaller, less distinct horizontal scratches on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive annular scarring across the ventral surface and one significant linear rake mark on the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: The scars exhibit a distinct 'O' shape with dark centers, creating a unique texture against the black pigment.
